name: @aop/ingestion
description: AOP Node.js ingestion + attribution service: receives edge-proxy intent telemetry (Worker Ingestion Engine), Shopify order-created webhooks (Webhook Receiver Engine), stitches cookie-less attribution via X-Agent-Transaction-Token, and sweeps expired intents into loss_diagnostics.

scripts.test: node --test test/auth.test.mjs test/commission.test.mjs test/loss-classifier.test.mjs test/shopify-hmac.test.mjs test/validate-telemetry.test.mjs test/analytics-params.test.mjs test/token-crypto.test.mjs test/shopify-oauth.test.mjs test/intent-classifier.test.mjs test/routing-config.test.mjs test/rate-limit.test.mjs test/webhooks-adjustments.test.mjs test/api-keys.test.mjs test/analytics-auth.test.mjs test/analytics-lift.test.mjs
